## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 20 user-facing changes.
### Improved
- The WebKit build now runs on the same Mac app shell as the Chromium build, so both reopen the windows you left open in the order you left them, and both put links from other apps where your link settings say even with no window open. The first launch after this update reopens your most recently used window at its default size. - The Chromium build's Edit menu now has Find, Spelling and Grammar, Substitutions, Transformations and Speech, Translate Page appears in the Page menu whenever a page can be translated, and Command-W closes Crest Setup and What's New in Crest there too.
### Fixed
- A tab or window an extension closes now closes in Crest instead of leaving a blank tab behind, and a site can close only a tab or window that another page opened. - The Dock keeps the app icon you picked while downloads run. - Windows and tabs an extension opens, such as a password manager's pop-out, can close themselves again when they're done. - A search from a new tab on iPhone shows its page right away instead of a blank screen. - Setup no longer waits forever when iCloud doesn't answer: after a few seconds you can set up without it, and sync tries iCloud again on its own. - A Quick Window whose page closes itself, such as a sign-in window once you're signed in, now closes even while it's asking whether you want to leave the page. - Videos you play full screen, such as on YouTube, show again instead of a black screen. - In full screen, the title bar that slides down with the menu bar looks like the standard one instead of a blank block over the page. - Pages get first say over shortcuts such as ⌘F, as in other browsers, so a document editor like Google Docs opens its own Find. ⌘T, ⌘W and ⌘N always stay Crest's. - Now Playing shows the track's artwork again for pages that run in Chromium, including artwork from sites you're signed in to, sized to fit music and video.

## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 95 user-facing changes.
### New
- Chromium feature flags open inside Crest Settings.
### Improved
- In the desktop browser, camera, microphone, location and notification requests use Crest's own prompt, are remembered per Space, and can be reviewed and revoked in Site Controls and Privacy. - Tab icons in the desktop browser take on a site's theme colour, and refreshing a site's icon works there too. - Split cards and Peek in the desktop browser zoom pages with a fixed minimum width to fit, as they do on WebKit. - An extension side panel requested from a Quick Window now explains that side panels open in the main window. - Crest's link and Space actions appear first in native page menus while browser and extension actions stay available. - Page dialogs and website sign-in prompts work across both desktop browser engines. - Playing Chromium videos can enter Picture in Picture when switching tabs, with a window that settles into a screen corner.
### Fixed
- Clear Site Data and Reload works in the desktop browser. - Extensions that open their side panel themselves, such as ChatGPT, now open it on the first click in the desktop browser. - Extensions that work with a companion app, such as ChatGPT, 1Password and Claude, now connect to it in the desktop browser even when the app was only set up for Chrome. - Keep unfinished page loads from changing saved tabs or history while preserving completed page titles and icons.
